headline: Cirrus Logic and MathWorks authors report reusing system models in mixed-signal verification
fact: A DVCon U.S. 2025 paper by Cirrus Logic and MathWorks authors describes generating SystemVerilog DPI-C components from system-level models for reuse in mixed-signal verification. A reported test ran in 30 seconds with DPI-C versus 51 seconds with a user-defined nettype and 54 seconds with Verilog-AMS. The paper also contrasts two projects whose closed-loop verification began 18 and 43 weeks after RTL availability; those project timings are not presented as a controlled comparison.
